# P27.7 (LAUNCH.7) — Empty-states, honest-gap UX & polish at national scale

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/P27.7__empty-states-and-polish.md` · **Base:** `devin/p27-6-ia-redesign-landing`
· **Stacked PR** (no merge/tag/push-main). Pure `web/` change; zero-JS preserved.

## Summary
Takes the redesigned, data-wired public surface (P27.5/P27.6) to launch quality: every aggregate
surface now renders a **designed, honest empty/partial/gap state** instead of a blank list or a
fabricated zero; the national-scale tables gain **build-time grouping/summarisation and zero-JS
static-link sorting**; epistemic legibility (support glyph, contested marker, evidence-class
downgrade) is verified consistent on real claims with contradictions kept visible; and the surface is
responsive with the council-ready dossier print/PDF intact. Absence is rendered as a visible gap with
a clickable task affordance — never a guess, never a blank (§3.1, SIG-UI-007).

## What changed
- **New `web/src/lib/empty.ts`** — pure honest empty-state copy for 21 aggregate surfaces (heading +
  not-yet-researched framing + task affordance); no colour/markup, so the honesty rules are unit-tested.
- **New `web/src/components/EmptyState.astro`** — a designed absence block using the single hatch
  texture + a plain-GET CTA (no JS).
- **New `web/src/lib/tables.ts`** — `sortRows` (stable, tiebroken), `sortHref`, `summariseBy` — the
  build-time large-table primitives.
- **Empty states wired** into `index.astro` (jurisdiction reach), `coverage-metrics.astro`,
  `watch.astro` (×4: watch/subscriptions/recommender/citations), `corrections.astro`,
  `research-queue.astro` (×2), `network.astro` (×5), `map.astro` (×3), `evidence/index.astro`,
  `dossier/index.astro`, and a zero-gap branch in `WhatWeDontKnow.astro`. The per-field "not
  researched" AbsenceHatch is preserved.
- **`data-freshness.astro` → `data-freshness/[...sort].astro`** — a pre-rendered route per sort order
  (`/`, `/status/`, `/stale/`, `/volatility/`) reached by plain GET links (no client JS); a build-time
  "At a glance" status band + volatility breakdown; capRows retained. Base `/data-freshness/` unchanged.
- **`map.astro`** — build-time per-jurisdiction summary band over the located-assets table + a
  `.sig-table-wrap` horizontal-scroll wrapper; capRows retained; empty states for assets/bins/indicators.
- **`epistemic.css`** — a P27.7 section: the empty-state block, the summary band, static sort links,
  `.sig-table-wrap`, responsive `@media (max-width:40rem)` tweaks, and print rules that hide the sort
  chrome and expand table wrappers. Neutral greyscale tokens only — no `--sig-epi-*` added (SIG-UI-006).
- **Tests** — `tests/unit/empty.test.ts` (honest-copy contract; no fabricated zero), `tests/unit/tables.test.ts`
  (sort + summarise), `tests/e2e/large-table.nojs.spec.ts` (no-JS: summary band + static sort routes
  re-order the table), `tests/e2e/epistemic-scale.nojs.spec.ts` (glyph/downgrade/contested consistency;
  contradictions visible); `pages.ts` adds the freshness sort routes to the axe/WCAG sweep.

## Design decisions
- **Static-link sorting, not client JS.** The shell ships zero JS, so "sortable" is realised as one
  pre-rendered page per sort order reached by a GET link (`[...sort]` rest route) — the ordering lives
  in the HTML, archivable and screen-reader-navigable.
- **Empty ≠ zero.** Every empty body frames absence as *not-yet-researched* and links to the research
  queue (a gap is an invitation). A landing "0 sources" only ever appears beside its named denominator
  (§32); the coverage no-total gate is unchanged.
- **No epistemic data fabricated.** Deliverable 3 is delivered as verification (glyph/contested/downgrade
  already render on live network/watch/evidence and are asserted consistent) — wiring new epistemic
  fields onto surfaces that lack them would be a P27.4 data-shape change (out of scope).
- **`[...sort]` is a variant of an existing surface, not a new page** (out-of-scope guard honored).
- No new ADR: this implements the P27.6 design system within its established tokens; no landed decision
  changes and no SHOULD-level deviation.
